_comment_data_mix: Enrollment presence is driven by custom.enrollment_audio, NOT by probability. Training corpora MUST mix TS-ASR cuts (with enrollment) AND single-speaker supervisions (without enrollment) so the model learns when to condition on the reference clip.
_comment_prompt_probs: prompt_hotword_prob / prompt_language_prob are the probabilities of KEEPING the respective prompt line (0.8 => each line appears in ~80% of samples).
